description: Integration with Google Calendar, Gmail, Google Drive, and Google Maps API.
capabilities: Drive file retrieval and cloud backup

settings.NUXIVA_GOOGLE_REMIND_MIN: Remind me before an appointment (minutes, 0 = never)

guide.title: How to get your Google Client ID and Client Secret
steps: Open Google Cloud Console and sign in with your Google account.
Click the project selector at the top, then “New project”, name it for example “Nuxiva” and create it.
Open the API Library and enable: Google Calendar API, Gmail API, Google Tasks API, People API (contacts) and Google Drive API.
Open the OAuth consent screen: choose “External”, enter the app name and your email, then under “Test users” add the Google addresses of everyone who will use Nuxiva.
Open Credentials, “Create credentials”, “OAuth client ID” and choose “Desktop app” as the application type.
Copy the Client ID and Client Secret, paste them below and press Save.
Each person links their own account from People, Connectors tab, Google: pick the services and authorise on Google's page.
guide.note: While the app stays in “Testing” mode authorisation expires every 7 days: publish the app from the consent screen to avoid it. Keep the Client Secret private.

help.NUXIVA_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID: Ends with .apps.googleusercontent.com. Find it under Credentials, OAuth client ID.
help.NUXIVA_GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET: Private string starting with GOCSPX-, shown next to the Client ID.
